dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Chiquita was surrendered by her previous owner due to the owner's pregnancy affecting the ability to provide proper care for Chiquita. Her previous family described her as a social but independent, affectionate, low-energy dog. She would spend most of her time in the living room of the home. She is noted to be selective with grooming, but most of the time did not allow; she loves going for car rides, eating, and spending time with her people. Chiquita does have a bite history after getting separated from her family several years ago. She is reported to have bitten her finder when they picked her up, but further details about the incident were unknown after she was brought to the care center as a stray. Chiquits is noted to preder contact on her own terms with strangers, but has escalated to higher level warnings when her intial boundaries are not respected. Due to these concerns, we recommend for Chiquita to be palced in an adult only home through a New Hope rescue parnter that can allow her the time and space to decompress at her own pace.
dog.name: Chiquita
